study.question: Do count-preserving temporal UF history slots and task-specific score readouts complement one another under the frozen ownership gates, improving validation click AUC beyond both frozen source bests at justified capacity and measured cost?
study.hypothesis: UF compression can regularize target-history scoring while preserving event mass. Separate auxiliary score rows may extract task-relevant summaries of those same slots and yield more useful updates to shared context embeddings. In this deliberately source-faithful implementation, task readouts do not change the click score function directly; their only permitted inter-task route to click is shared context embeddings. Useful complementarity requires the combined cell to beat both source bests and both component controls. This hypothesis is provisional and does not follow from the small difference between the two source AUCs.

inherited_components: Released feature embedding interface and four separate prediction towers from the local DIN adaptation
Temporal UF mean summaries and count-preserving pooling from g2-r0004-context_only
Action-aware score trunk, identically initialized task readout rows and gradient ownership from g3-r0003-embedding_item_primary
Exact frozen host inputs, visibility, data split, optimizers, single pass, precision, scoring and budget
study.proposed_difference: Compose UF compression with the task-row scorer, then cross compression on/off with task readout on/off in one source-equivalent 2x2 suite. All cells allocate the same [128,32] score trunk, four readout rows and [128,64] task towers. Shared cells use only the click readout row and detach auxiliary score paths; task cells train the three auxiliary readout rows using detached hidden states. Auxiliary values and direct target embeddings are detached in every cell; context embeddings remain jointly trained. No custom loss is used.
predictions: Primary utility prediction: compressed_task click AUC > 0.660646940486458, exceeding both frozen g2 (0.660646940486458) and g3 (0.660163362657485), not merely the DIN value 0.6555440824200336.

Mechanism prediction: compressed_task exceeds compressed_shared and events_task, and the predeclared interaction I is positive. One seed remains exploratory; no statistical significance or repeated support is claimed.

Resource prediction: all four allocated parameter counts match the g3 source (expected 32088328 total / 31793216 embedding / 295112 dense, subject to host audit); compression reduces scoring positions 100 to 30, but actual full-unit time, GPU allocation, peak memory, throughput and batch latency must establish efficiency.
Auxiliary AUC/Logloss may differ substantially. Report each task, mean and auxiliary mean separately; auxiliary recovery alone does not meet the click objective.

Predeclared diagnostic groups are empty history, lengths 1-16,17-64,65-100, plus existing authorized training-defined field-frequency/time/feedback slices if host supports them. Provide sample, positive and negative counts and mark insufficient groups; do not infer mechanisms from unpaired slices.
falsifiers: Failure of compressed_task to exceed the stronger frozen source falsifies useful complementarity for this implementation, even if it exceeds DIN.
Failure of a component contrast or nonpositive interaction does not support synergistic compression/task scoring; an additive win must be described as additive.
An improvement explainable by the extra active readout rows, changed Dice populations, source width, table aliasing or greater measured cost does not establish the proposed information mechanism.
Failure of full-event source parity, masking, ownership gradients or finite outputs is an implementation/integrity failure, not scientific evidence against the hypothesis.
Disappearance or sign reversal in authorized paired repetitions/cluster uncertainty weakens the initial conclusion; a one-seed marginal gain is preliminary.
alternative_explanations: Both imported source bests were selected using validation and have no independent paired repetitions available; their 0.000483577828973 click gap may reflect selection or seed variation.
Compression can regularize by discarding distinctions rather than preserving a complementary representation, and Dice statistics see 30 slots rather than 100.
Auxiliary score rows add 99 active parameters; identical allocated parameter totals do not equal identical functional capacity.
The wider scorer and altered RNG relative to the g2 source can explain a source-level gain; only same-suite contrasts isolate the declared changes.

Both source architectures greatly degrade auxiliary performance relative to DIN, consistent with a tradeoff from blocked auxiliary item/trunk gradients, but the available three records do not isolate that causal explanation.
No raw event times are supplied and official_offline feedback can be immature in deployment; results do not establish point-in-time production validity.
Unexpected cross-field embedding aliases would weaken the claimed source-path ownership and must be audited, not silently assumed absent.

evidence_review.scope: Only the baseline and the two explicitly imported source trials are available as local observations. Agent-memory search returned no records. No failed/abandoned source trial outcome is available; ancestry names alone are not evidence and are not imported as local results. Full task and source hashes checked against public files; raw parquets and GPU execution are host-owned and not present for independent verification in this coding phase.
evidence_review.observation: The compressed source is better on click and measured wall/memory, while the task-conditioned source is stronger for cart/fav but weaker for buy. Both are much weaker than DIN on auxiliary AUC. These are selected single-seed source-level observations; no complementarity mechanism is established.
evidence_review.nearest_work_status: DIN primary archived mechanism text and pinned HeMix/INFNet benchmark source were read. Original HeMix/INFNet full text was explicitly unavailable through authorized references; this limits novelty assessment rather than proving originality. No novelty claim is made.

host_checks_before_training: Verify frozen protocol/source/data identities using the existing host adapter. Do not rebuild inputs, alter training settings or use withheld feedback.

Instantiate all cells using the same actual FeatureMap, frozen seed and row-tied readout initialization. Require equal state dictionaries and parameter counts across all four before training. Count active readout difference separately (three unused 33-parameter rows in shared cells).

For events_task, compare the source g3 model state, training/evaluation predictions, separate task-loss gradients and Dice buffers on cloned batches with identical state and seed. Require BF16-appropriate numerical tolerances; no training or efficacy interpretation until source parity passes. Minor summation-order differences must be documented, not silently ignored.

Test [B,1] finite probabilities for all four labels, finite summed-BCE backward, mixed and all-empty histories, a single valid event, and all/non-auxiliary/mixed feedback masks. Missing/malformed task masks must fail rather than invoke framework fallback.

Perturb masked history IDs and masked historical actions within valid vocabularies and the unknown target-action position; outputs, gradients and persistent Dice buffers must remain invariant under matched state in train and eval. Never perturb valid supplied information as a claimed invariance.

Check slot counts and count-weighted feature mass against direct masked sums. Uniform and the union of feedback strata must each cover every valid event once; the chosen task route must not double count. No current action or label may enter any score, slot assignment or input.

Audit loss paths by source: click loss updates item/action/context, score trunk, click readout and click tower; auxiliary losses update context, their own tower and (task cells only) their own readout rows, with zero gradients into item/action embeddings, trunk and click row. Audit actual embedding sharing aliases before interpreting source ownership.

At common untrained weights, shared/task predictions agree within each compression cell because score rows start equal. Their click computational graph is identical apart from later shared-context learning; a discrepancy is a bug.

Measure all four full-protocol validation tasks, counts, logloss, primary AUC, allowed slices and measured training/inference costs. Retain all failure receipts and charged costs. Do not score the holdout.
